mainEntity.name: What ERP invoicing and compliance standards does Jacob Chademwiri work with?

acceptedAnswer.text: He has hands-on experience using SAP, Sage, and Zoho for commercial invoicing, purchase order reconciliation, and accounts receivable, alongside MFMA/SCM compliance, CIDB requirements, and Management Representative leadership for ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001.
